biotools.summary: BGMDB is a curated database linking gut microbiota dysbiosis to brain disorders, compiling experimental data on associations between gut microbes and brain diseases, neurotransmitters, and genetic factors. It provides a user-friendly interface for researchers to explore these connections and facilitate therapeutic strategies.
